description: Knowledge Base of company facts, processes, voice and support guidance. kind: guide = the one Operating Guide; procedure = numbered steps + whenToUse; default knowledge. list: 5 per page, guide pinned first, remaining pages in saved order; search: hasMore marks further pages; total is a lower bound unless totalIsExact. Returns snippets and section offsets, plus didYouMean when a misspelled word was corrected. get: one Markdown chunk (outline at 0); nextOffset is the offset of the following chunk and null at the end; updatedAt changes when the page changed between chunks; anchor reads one section. move: places page id before or after targetId in the saved order; the Operating Guide stays pinned first, so it can neither move nor serve as targetId. gaps: questions the Knowledge Base could not answer (editors). delete moves the page to Trash, where it is deleted permanently after 30 days; the returned trashBatchId identifies the Trash batch it can be restored from. Pages link as /wiki?page=<id>; ids survive renames.

action.description: list: page, kind; search: query, page; get: id, offset or anchor; create: pages, requireEmpty; update: id, expectedUpdatedAt, title, markdown, kind, whenToUse; move: id, targetId, placement; delete: id, expectedUpdatedAt. update changes only the supplied title, markdown, kind and whenToUse, at least one of them, as top-level fields.

anchor.description: Section anchor as returned by a search hit; get returns only that section.

markdown.description: Markdown with actual newline characters; escaped backslash-n separators are rejected.

placement.description: move only: before or after targetId in the saved order.

requireEmpty.description: Only into an empty Knowledge Base.

targetId.description: move only: the reference page this page is placed beside.
